zh: 桌面 Agent 设置里 Codex 卡片提示的修复命令改为脚本的完整绝对路径，在任意目录下打开终端都能直接复制运行；网页发送失败时的报错提示同样给出完整路径。
删除侧栏「任务」里正打开的对话（含 Codex、Claude Code 等第三方 Agent 和频道对话）后，中间区域会立即回到新对话，不再残留已删除的内容；第三方 Agent 对话的移除会先确认，并在刷新后保持隐藏。
en: The Codex fix command shown in Desktop Agent settings now uses the script's full absolute path, so it runs as-is from any Terminal directory; the send-failure message shows the same full path.

Removing a conversation that is open in the Tasks sidebar (including Codex, Claude Code and other third-party agent or channel chats) now returns the main area to a new chat instead of leaving the removed content on screen; removing a third-party chat asks for confirmation and stays hidden after a refresh.
